Package gov.Lab3

Class Programmer

java.lang.Object
gov.Lab3.Person
gov.Lab3.Programmer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Profile, Comparable<Profile>
public class Programmer extends Person
A Person who is also a software programmer.

In addition to everything a regular person can do, a Programmer can execute arbitrary code via executeCode(java.util.function.Function<T, R>, T).

    • executeCode

      public <T, R> R executeCode(Function<T,R> code, T input)
      Applies the supplied function to the given input and returns the result.

      This models the ability of a programmer to execute code.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the function's input
      R - the type of the function's output
      Parameters:
      code - the function to execute
      input - the argument passed to the function
      Returns:
      the result of code.apply(input)
